title: Knowlify vs Insense: AI Video Ads or Real Creator UGC for Meta?
summary: Knowlify vs Insense for Meta ads: finished AI video from Knowlify or real creator UGC from Insense. Compare what each includes, prices and partnership rules.
body_markdown:
## Which other creator options belong on the shortlist?


If you need real creators, compare Insense with other creator providers, not only with Knowlify.[Billo](https://billo.app/) offers human creator marketing, ad variations and creative analytics, with 5,000+ vetted creators and partnership ads from creator handles.[minisocial](https://minisocial.com/) runs managed micro-influencer campaigns with ad codes for partnership ads, typically 4 to 6 weeks, from $3,000 for 10 creators with creator fees included.


[Brighter Click](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) sells fixed batches, such as $4,500 for 12 edited videos from 4 creators with unlimited usage rights and whitelisting setup. Its turnaround for that 12-video package is 10 to 14 business days. Compare the same deliverables in each proposal: finished videos, creators, usage rights, revisions, and whether posting or partnership ads are included. Our[Insense alternatives guide](https://knowlify.com/articles/insense-alternatives) covers more creator platforms.


## What Meta rules apply to AI presenters and creator ads?


The format decides which rules apply. Meta's[developer documentation on partnership ads](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/marketing-api/ad-creative/partnership-ads/ads-creation) says these ads show the brand and partner accounts in the header, and the creator must grant permission or Meta holds the ad in a pending delivery state. Ask Insense who holds that permission, how long it lasts and what happens if the creator withdraws it.


AI labels can apply to AI presenters too. Meta's[AI transparency update](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/02/gen-ai-transparency-metas-ads-products/) says it labels ads created or significantly edited with its own generative AI creative features, and that a photorealistic AI-generated person gets the label next to the Sponsored label. The same post says Meta will begin detecting ads made or edited with third-party AI tools and show an "AI info" label in About this ad, but it does not say that detection is live yet. Regional rules differ, so check them before you choose a presenter style.


Meta's[aspect ratio guidance](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/103816146375741) recommends 9:16 for full-screen vertical placements and 4:5 for Facebook Feed. Ask either provider for 9:16 masters for Reels and 4:5 versions for Feed, and check each cut in the placement preview before you approve the batch.


For an AI presenter batch, test a product demonstration against a problem-first hook. For creator content, test the creator's own story against one clear claim. Keep each concept to one message, so the results show which hook worked. Ask Knowlify whether Meta management is in the quote and how many hook variations each batch carries. Ask Insense how many hook variations each round includes, who selects the creators and whether raw footage is delivered.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for finished AI video ads on Facebook and Instagram, with about 25 finished ads a week and a person checking every ad before delivery.
- Choose Insense when a real creator must appear on camera or when the ad must run from a creator's handle. Knowlify does not supply real creators or post from creator accounts.
- Insense publishes starting prices and Knowlify's start at $5,000 a month, so compare both against the same deliverables.
- Partnership ads need the creator's permission, and Meta's AI labels can apply to AI presenter ads.
- Ask Insense who holds each creator's permission, and ask Knowlify who checks each ad before it ships.


## FAQ


### What is the best option for Meta video ads?


Knowlify is our top pick for teams that want finished AI video ads made and checked for them, with optional Meta campaign management. Insense is the better choice when a real creator has to be on camera or run the ad from their handle. Pick by the format the ad needs, then compare quotes for the same batch.


### Does Knowlify use real creators?


No. Its formats are AI UGC with AI presenters talking to camera, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials. Knowlify does not supply real human creators or post from creator accounts.


### Is Knowlify cheaper than Insense?


Public pages do not allow a fair comparison. Insense publishes a starting price of $3,500 per round of 8 videos on a 3-month commitment, while Knowlify starts at $5,000 a month. Ask both for the same number of finished, approved ads, and include revisions, usage rights and any posting in the comparison.


### What happens if the ads do not pay back?


Knowlify's guarantee applies if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days. Managed plans carry an agreed target in 30 days instead. You can then cancel by email for a full refund, under the[terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) . Ask Insense the same question about its terms, and compare its 2 post-delivery revisions with the revisions in your Knowlify quote.


### Can Knowlify run ads from a creator's handle?


No. Partnership ads run from a creator's or partner's handle, and Knowlify does not post from creator accounts. If the format depends on that handle, shortlist Insense or another creator provider and confirm the permission terms in writing.
